result.reason: The added ownership clause reaches the preferred position: the Company owns the Site-related deliverables and work product through an express assignment, HDI retains its pre-existing IP while granting a perpetual, irrevocable, worldwide, royalty-free licence to embedded materials, Company customer data remains with the Company, and joint ownership is disclaimed. The business-purpose limitation is consistent with the fallback and does not materially undermine use of the deliverables. The change is appropriately confined to ownership, although references to ownership and assignment of all user information may be broader than legally necessary and could be qualified for third-party rights and applicable data-protection law.
